Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the wrist. Imaging was consistent with a
wrist fracture, and the reported mechanism of injury is well matched to the force of the crash. Over the course of eleven visits,
care proceeded along a typical trajectory: immobilization, pain management, and progressive range-of-motion and strengthening
work. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. On examination, localized tenderness and
reduced grip strength over the fractured area are present and support the diagnosis, while neurovascular checks, sensation, and the
remaining joint tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior inujry to this area, and no earlier records of wirst

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
